context: Riku and Aoi photograph the neighborhood.
purpose: Casual register; daily vocabulary (カメラ/あたり/周り/コース/タイプ) in natural home.

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: このカメラ、僕には難しいタイプだよ。
lines.en: This camera is a tricky type for me.
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, bright warm engaged delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あたりが暗いと、難しいよね。
lines.en: When the area's dark, it's hard.
lines.style: helpful barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 周りの建物を、撮ってみるよ。
lines.en: I'll try shooting the surrounding buildings.
lines.style: eager teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 駅前のコースが、撮りやすいよ。
lines.en: The course by the station is easy to shoot.
lines.style: cheerful barista voice, soft warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: このタイプのカメラ、軽くていいね。
lines.en: This type of camera is nice and light.
lines.style: pleased teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: あたりを見回して、いい角度を探そう。
lines.en: Look around the area and find a good angle.
lines.style: engaged barista voice, soft warm cheerful delivery throughout

lines.speaker: riku_teen
lines.jp: 周りの人も、撮っていい?
lines.en: Can I photograph the people around too?
lines.style: curious teen boy voice, bright warm delivery throughout

lines.speaker: aoi_barista
lines.jp: 一声かけてね。さあ、コースを進もう!
lines.en: Ask them first. Now, let's move along the course!
lines.style: bright barista voice, soft warm cheerful closing delivery throughout
